tag: 詢問車站附近街道為何封閉

level.why: Why 問句，正解含間接指引與不確定回答，需聽懂意圖。

q.t: Why did they close the street near the station this morning?
q.zh: 為什麼他們今天早上封閉了車站附近的街道？

pool.t: I heard a water pipe burst under the road.
pool.zh: 我聽說路面下有水管爆裂。
pool.why: 正解：直接說明封街原因。

pool.t: The street is very long and narrow.
pool.why: 重複 street，但沒有回答原因。

pool.t: You'd better ask the officer over there.
pool.zh: 你最好去問那邊的警察。
pool.why: 正解：建議詢問他人，間接回應。

pool.t: I'll take these clothes, please.
pool.why: clothes 與 close 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: At the corner of Main Street.
pool.why: 回答地點，答非所問。

pool.t: I just got here, so I'm not sure.
pool.why: 正解：表示不知道原因。

pool.t: The station has a new ticket machine.
pool.why: 與車站相關，但沒有說明原因。

pool.t: About twenty minutes by bus.
pool.why: 回答時間長短，答非所問。

pool.t: Mr. Kim, from the city office.
pool.why: 回答人物，答非所問。

pool.t: This morning I woke up at six.
pool.why: 重複 this morning，但沒有回答原因。

pool.t: I will close it tomorrow morning.
pool.zh: 我明天早上會把它關起來。
pool.why: 人稱與時態錯誤。

pool.t: Parking is free near the station.
pool.why: 與車站相關，但沒有說明原因。

tag: 詢問錯過十點車後是否還有較晚班次

level.why: 含條件子句的 Yes/No 問句，正解為直答、指引、需查證。

q.t: If we miss the ten o'clock, is there a later train to the coast?
q.zh: 如果我們錯過十點那班，還有較晚到海邊的火車嗎？

pool.t: The coast is beautiful this time of year.
pool.why: 重複 coast，但沒有回答。

pool.t: Yes, there's another one at eleven fifteen.
pool.zh: 有，十一點十五分還有一班。
pool.why: 正解：直接肯定並給出時間。

pool.t: The mist was thick this morning.
pool.why: mist 與 miss 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: At the ticket office downstairs.
pool.why: 回答地點，答非所問。

pool.t: Check the board over there; it's updated hourly.
pool.zh: 去看那邊的看板，每小時更新。
pool.why: 正解：指引查看看板，間接回答。

pool.t: We missed the bus to the coast last week.
pool.zh: 我們上週錯過了去海邊的公車。
pool.why: 時態與人稱不符，沒有回答。

pool.t: Two adults and one child.
pool.why: 回答人數，答非所問。

pool.t: Let me look it up for you.
pool.why: 正解：表示需要查證。

pool.t: It rained heavily all night.
pool.why: rained 與 train 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: I like to travel to the coast.
pool.why: 重複 coast，但沒有回答。

pool.t: About fifteen minutes.
pool.why: 回答時間長短，答非所問。

pool.t: The café in the station opens at six.
pool.zh: 車站裡的咖啡店六點開門。
pool.why: 與車站相關，但沒有回答。

tag: 詢問走路口號誌或地下道較快

level.why: 選擇疑問句，正解含選一、第三選項與皆可，干擾項音近且自然。

q.t: Would it be faster to cross at the lights or use the underpass?
q.zh: 在路口號誌過馬路比較快，還是走地下道比較快？

pool.t: The underpass, especially with all this traffic.
pool.zh: 走地下道，尤其車這麼多。
pool.why: 正解：選擇地下道並附理由。

pool.t: The lights in my kitchen are broken.
pool.why: 重複 lights，但意思不符。

pool.t: Neither, there's a footbridge by the bakery.
pool.zh: 都不用，麵包店旁有天橋。
pool.why: 正解：提出第三選項。

pool.t: I'd like more pasta, please.
pool.zh: 我想再要一些義大利麵。
pool.why: pasta 與 faster 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: At half past three.
pool.why: 回答時間，答非所問。

pool.t: Either one is fine, they're about equal.
pool.why: 正解：表示兩者皆可。

pool.t: My boss is in a meeting.
pool.why: boss 與 cross 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: There's a pharmacy across the road.
pool.why: 與過馬路相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: The underpass was built in 1990.
pool.zh: 地下道是一九九零年蓋的。
pool.why: 重複 underpass，但沒有回答。

pool.t: Yes, I do it every day.
pool.why: 用 Yes 回答選擇題，答非所問。

pool.t: Pedestrians should always look both ways.
pool.why: 與過馬路相關，但沒有選擇。

pool.t: He crossed the river by boat yesterday.
pool.why: 時態與人稱不符，沒有回答。

tag: 確認對方是否說過這條街通往舊市場

level.why: 附加問句，正解含確認、更正與含糊回應，干擾項自然。

q.t: You said this street leads to the old market, didn't you?
q.zh: 你說過這條街通往舊市場，對吧？

pool.t: I made my bed this morning.
pool.why: bed 與 said 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: Yes, about five minutes further on.
pool.why: 正解：確認並補充距離。

pool.t: The old market sells fresh fruit.
pool.why: 重複 old market，但沒有確認。

pool.t: Because I was running late.
pool.why: 回答原因，答非所問。

pool.t: Actually, I said the next street over.
pool.zh: 其實我說的是隔壁那條街。
pool.why: 正解：更正說法。

pool.t: It's about two kilometers long.
pool.why: 回答長度，答非所問。

pool.t: The market opens at seven on Sundays.
pool.why: 與市場相關，但沒有確認。

pool.t: I was just guessing, to be honest.
pool.why: 正解：承認不確定，間接回應。

pool.t: This street is under repair.
pool.why: 重複 street，但沒有確認。

pool.t: Mr. Chen, from the tourist office.
pool.why: 回答人物，答非所問。

pool.t: There's a good bakery near the fountain.
pool.zh: 噴水池附近有間不錯的麵包店。
pool.why: 與街道相關，但沒有確認。

pool.t: We walked to the old market last year.
pool.zh: 我們去年走路去過舊市場。
pool.why: 時態與人稱不符，沒有確認。

tag: 請對方示範如何儲值交通卡

level.why: 禮貌請求，正解含接受、附理由婉拒與反問細節，干擾項自然。

q.t: Would you mind showing me how to top up this transit card?
q.zh: 你可以示範一下怎麼儲值這張交通卡嗎？

pool.t: Sure, the machine is right over here.
pool.why: 正解：接受請求。

pool.t: The guard is on his break.
pool.why: guard 與 card 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: I'd love to, but my train is boarding now.
pool.zh: 我很想，但我的火車正在上車。
pool.why: 正解：拒絕並附理由。

pool.t: The crowd is growing outside.
pool.why: growing 與 showing 音近，內容無關。

pool.t: I got this card as a gift last year.
pool.zh: 這張卡是我去年收到的禮物。
pool.why: 重複 card，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: Is it a prepaid card or a monthly pass?
pool.why: 正解：詢問細節再決定。

pool.t: Transit workers are on strike today.
pool.zh: 交通工作人員今天罷工。
pool.why: 重複 transit，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: At eleven thirty sharp.
pool.why: 回答時間，答非所問。

pool.t: Yes, it was very crowded.
pool.why: 用 Yes 回答請求，內容不符。

pool.t: The station café sells coffee and sandwiches.
pool.zh: 車站咖啡店賣咖啡和三明治。
pool.why: 與車站相關，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: My commute is about an hour each way.
pool.why: 與交通相關，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: She topped up hers yesterday morning.
pool.zh: 她昨天早上儲值了她的。
pool.why: 時態與人稱不符，沒有回應請求。
